annotations.title: Book several Royal Mail orders and print their labels

description: Book multiple Royal Mail orders at once (up to 50), then fetch the labels and merge them into one PDF, ready to print. Every order booked costs money. Use this when the user pastes a list of orders/addresses. All orders share the same service, package format and sender. Saving labels through the API needs a Royal Mail Online Business Account. On other accounts the orders are still booked and reported, and the labels are printed from the Click & Drop website. An order that is booked but has no saved label is reported with its orderIdentifier, so never book it again. Saves to ~/Downloads/parcel-toolkit/ (overridable via PARCEL_TOOLKIT_LABELS_DIR).

despatchDate.description: Planned despatch date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit if the account does not allow future-dated orders.

packageFormat.description: Package format for every order in the batch.

sender.description: Sender address. Omit to use the address saved in your Click & Drop account.

service.description: Royal Mail service for every order in this batch (e.g. "tracked-24", "tracked-48", "first-class", "special-delivery-1000"). Call list_services for full catalogue.

shipments.description: Array of orders to book, at most 50. Each entry is one order with its own recipient, weight and reference.

reference.description: Internal order reference for this shipment

subtotal.description: Order subtotal in GBP (used for customs/insurance)

weightGrams.description: Weight in grams for this order (e.g. 500 for 500g)

name: book_batch_and_label
